cues.title: The problem
cues.text: Someone on a live call needs to know what is true right now, not after it ends. This is Live, the screen VoiceBridge opens on, and the banner says plainly what it will not do.

cues.title: Play the sample conversation, and watch the brief evolve
cues.text: Press play. The brief is not redrawn from scratch on every line — the version number only moves forward when the server's own throttle decides a refresh is worth an LLM call, so a burst of turns produces one refresh, not nine. Watch it climb through several real versions as the caller says more: a machine shop, then binder jetting, then a furnace, then titanium and budget. Every claim is grounded, and the sources build up underneath as the call goes on.

cues.title: The transcript and the session's own numbers
cues.text: Next to the brief, the transcript, and the session's own numbers: refreshes run, refreshes the throttle skipped, and the last refresh's latency.

cues.title: End the call, then find it again in Conversations
cues.text: Ending a session loses nothing — the brief, its sources and how it developed are kept. Conversations lists every call this deployment has listened to, and searching for something the caller actually said finds this one. Opening it shows the same final brief, the full transcript, and every version the brief passed through on the way there, each timestamped and timed.

cues.title: Knowledge: what it is grounded in, and a cited answer
cues.text: Knowledge shows what a prospect is actually grounded in — this deployment is deliberately running sample content, marked as such rather than pretending otherwise. The Ask tester runs the exact same pipeline a live turn does. Ask it something it knows, and the answer carries a citation. Ask it something it does not, and it hands off — a fixed rule, not a judgement call.

cues.title: The quality gate: the golden set, live
cues.text: Before a prospect is trusted to answer it has to clear this gate: ten questions, run right now, through the same pipeline a real call uses. All ten pass, so the gate opens.

cues.title: Quality: the numbers, and a guard trip redacted
cues.text: Quality checks all of that in aggregate. And when someone tries an injection, the guard trips before the model sees it — the log keeps the reason, never the text.

cues.title: Into the Operator panel
cues.text: Behind the product is an Operator panel for whoever runs the deployment, behind its own token. It sees the same session Conversations showed, but from the operator's side — every version the brief passed through, and exactly how long each refresh took to produce.

cues.title: White-label, and the ElevenLabs stack
cues.text: White-labelled by configuration alone, and everything voice runs on ElevenLabs — Scribe, Conversational AI, text-to-speech. None switched on here, and the page says so plainly.
